claim_boundary: TRAF-94 identifies primitive component response on the qualified H100 scope. TRAF-43 retains full collective accuracy and uncertainty; TRAF-54 retains integration into finite channel/GPU resources.

confirmation_model.data_curve: sum/reused data_work anchors, linear in useful bytes
confirmation_model.publication: add the pooled nonempty delayed-minus-ready response once
confirmation_model.rank_transfer: multiply no-delay rank-2 collective service by ranks-1
confirmation_model.sharing_curve: sum sharing anchors at 1920 bytes/channel, linear in channels
confirmation_model.uncertainty: propagate anchor IQRs with absolute interpolation/extrapolation weights, add component bounds, and apply the source rank multiplier
